metadata.description: drowzeys' DSpark-style speculative-decoding port for antirez's ds4 (DwarfStar) engine on one Spark: eight flag-gated C patches on antirez/ds4 80ebbc3 (replay-free row commits, suffix n-gram drafting, confidence stops, MTP-seeded verify rounds, acceptance scheduler, a decode-shaped q8 microbatch kernel, GB10 shared-staged int4 weight loads, batched draft chains and a trained Markov table, both off by default), built from a vendored, hash-checked source archive with the patches applied at image build. Serves antirez's DeepSeek-V4-Flash chat-v2 IQ2XXS/Q2K imatrix GGUF (81 GB) with the Q4K/Q8_0/F32 MTP GGUF, the pre-0731 files that upstream used (the library's other ds4 recipes use the 0731 files). Defaults are upstream's final DSpark configuration: --mtp-draft 5, --dspark-early-margin 3, --dspark-ngram 8, --dspark-row-commit, --dspark-rounds 16, --dspark-adapt, --dspark-mbatch. Upstream reports (not measured here) single-stream 20.0 tok/s on C code and 20.9 on JSON against 14.2 for antirez's published baseline (stock --mtp lost at 13.9 to 14.3), CLI with -c 8192, temperature 0. Licence MIT (ds4 and drowzeys' patches; model files carry DeepSeek's MIT licence). Not gated.
